study type: Retrospective case series and literature review
cohort: The study included four Chinese children with unexplained developmental delay or epilepsy, diagnosed with Lamb-Shaffer syndrome (LAMSHF) due to SOX5 gene variants.
finding: The study identified novel de novo and inherited SOX5 gene mutations in Chinese LAMSHF patients, confirming intellectual disability, speech delay, and facial dysmorphisms as common clinical manifestations, while seizures and EEG abnormalities were relatively rare.
